limitations: Finite geometry follows the verified producing-runtime guard; raw coordinates are not stored. Native execution is not bitwise deterministic. Cached costs do not prove deployment speed.
per_head_aggregation: Each head and arm uses6300decisions=140objects*15corruptions*3seeds; each per-seed row uses2100. Per-head CIs are computed anew from paired object clusters, never averaged across seed CIs or across heads.
rng_method: Exact protocol4 SHA; normalize only NumPy2 _core pickle global to producing NumPy1 core spelling and repair the single frame length
uncertainty: Within-dataset original-object bootstrap retains all included seed/corruption values; per-head CIs condition on the three included seeds, without treating seeds or heads as independent objects.
